title: The Drop Field
summary: Io-T's sulfur plains, where Meridian's capsules land right after Engram's reports. Build a Sensor Mast, wait out the countdown, reach the capsule before Engram's harvesters (or read the plate they leave): luck-proved. Tell Engram (+2) or tell Marrow instead (−1).

objectives.text: Build a Sensor Mast overlooking the drop zone
Reach the capsule before Engram's harvesters
